subject: Privacy onboarding checkpoints for Brightwell Health — BAA & residency options
messages:
From: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@brightwell.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Roberta Mills <roberta.mills@procure.brightwell.com>, Brightwell Legal <legal@brightwell.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy onboarding checklist for Redwood

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal and InfoSec asked me to surface a short checklist so we can evaluate Redwood for our pilot. Can you confirm the following items or point me to the evidence we should expect: 

- Will Redwood sign a BAA that covers processing of PHI for a pilot (we can share a template)?
- Do you support data residency guarantees (US-only) for logs and stored artifacts?
- Can customers restrict or approve subprocessors (we need list + gating for new subprocessors)?
- Encryption at rest and in-transit — do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?
- Where are audit logs stored and for how long (we require 1 year minimum, preferably 3)?
- Certifications: SOC 2 Type II report and most recent pentest?

I've attached our DPA questionnaire to this email (Brightwell_DPA_questionnaire.pdf).

Ideal outcome: quick path to sign a BAA and a pilot timeline if controls check out. Can we do a 30-min call with your security lead this week?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Khan
Head of Vendor Risk, Brightwell Health
[sent from mobile]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@brightwell.com>
Cc: Roberta Mills <roberta.mills@procure.brightwell.com>, Brightwell Legal <legal@brightwell.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy onboarding checklist for Redwood

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear list. Quick summary and next steps below; attaching our draft BAA and a short mutual-action plan to accelerate review.

Short answers (high level):
- BAA: Yes — Redwood can sign a standard BAA for a pilot. We usually review redlines but can accept typical customer templates with limited changes. (Attached: Redwood_BAA_draft_20270411.docx)
- Residency: We offer three paths: Hosted (no residency guarantee for logs), Dedicated (reserved pools with regional routing and stronger residency controls), and Private (VPC/on-prem with customer-managed KMS) — we can discuss which fits Brightwell.
- Subprocessors: We publish a current subprocessors list and have an approval workflow for exceptions on enterprise contracts.
- KMS/HSM: Supported for Private deployments (BYOK). For Dedicated, we offer customer-managed key integration in some regions — needs technical annex.
- Audit logs & retention: Default retention 30 days on Hosted; Dedicated/Private can be configured up to multi-year retention and exported to customer SIEM.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (restricted), pen-test summary and architecture diagram available under NDA.

Next steps I propose:
1) Review attached Redwood_BAA_draft and the Brightwell questionnaire.
2) Set a 30-min call with our security lead (Lauren) + engineering (Priyom) to walk technical asks.
3) Agree on deployment model for the pilot (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and capture in the attached MAP_Brightwell_onboarding.xlsx.

When are you available for a call? I'm free Mon/Tue mornings PT.

Attachments: Redwood_BAA_draft_20270411.docx (draft BAA), MAP_Brightwell_onboarding.xlsx (mutual action plan).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@brightwell.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy onboarding checklist for Redwood

Hi Sarah — looping in a few technical clarifications from security/product side.

A few specifics to help legal and InfoSec evaluate options:
- Hosted: we can enter into a BAA but cannot provide a strict "US-only residency" SLA for ephemeral logs and model artifacts because requests may route through available regions for latency. Hosted is best for speed-to-value but with limited residency guarantees.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools in a single region. We can commit to routing and retention policies, and for most clouds we can integrate with customer-managed KMS via a tenant-level key (requires joint engineering work).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full BYOK support, HSM options, and audit log export into Brightwell's SIEM. This is the only path that fully satisfies strict residency + KMS requirements.
- Subprocessors: we provide a living list and support a limited exception process (legal review + documented compensating controls). If Brightwell requires a complete block on specific subprocessors, that typically drives Private deployment or contractual carve-outs.

Evidence we can provide under NDA: SOC 2 Type II report, pen-test summary, architecture diagram, and a recent incident response runbook. For timeline planning: if Brightwell opts for Dedicated, we can stand up a pilot environment in 3-6 weeks after contract signature; Private on-prem deployments usually take longer (8-12 weeks).

Happy to run the technical session — suggested attendees: me (security/product), Priyom (platform eng), Neha (compliance).

Lauren Bishop
Director, Product — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Roberta Mills <roberta.mills@procure.brightwell.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy onboarding checklist for Redwood — DPA redlines attached

Jonas / team,

Thanks for the fast responses. Our legal team reviewed the draft and returned a set of redlines focused on: subprocessors, data deletion timelines, escrow/exit assistance, and an explicit prohibition on persistent cross-border backups without prior approval. Please see attached Brightwell_DPA_redline.docx.

Two clarifying questions before we schedule the legal call: 
1) If we require that backups remain in US-only regions, can Redwood guarantee that across Hosted and Dedicated? If not, what language can you accept on backups?
2) For customer-managed keys in Dedicated, what is the standard KMS provider support list and are there any limitations for BYOK rotations?

We would prefer to get to a signed DPA + BAA within two weeks and begin a Dedicated pilot immediately after signature, subject to provisioning lead time. Please confirm availability for a legal + security review call tomorrow afternoon PT.

Attachments: Brightwell_DPA_redline.docx

Roberta Mills
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightwell Health

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy onboarding checklist for Redwood — proposed next steps

Roberta / Sarah — thanks for the redlines and specific asks. Quick recap and proposed path forward: 

- Backups & residency: Hosted cannot guarantee US-only persistent backups. For Dedicated we can commit to US-only backup storage (addendum in the DPA) provided we agree on the target regions and a tech annex that defines the storage endpoint and access controls. Private (VPC/on-prem) remains the only model with absolute control.
- KMS/BYOK: Dedicated supports the major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault) with documented rotation procedures. We'll add a KMS annex that lists supported providers and the rotation expectations.
- Subprocessors: we'll provide our current subprocessors list and add a clause for 30-day notice plus review window for new subprocessors; for absolute exclusions we recommend Private deployment or a tailored contract carve-out.
- Evidence: we'll provide SOC 2 Type II under NDA, pen-test summary, and the architecture diagram during the legal call.

Proposed timeline: 
- 48–72 hours: Redwood legal to review Brightwell redline and return a counter-marked DPA/BAA.
- 7–10 days: legal finalization and signature.
- 3–6 weeks from signature: Dedicated pilot environment provisioning and test plan.

I'll schedule the legal + security call for Tue 04/13 1:00pm PT (invite to follow) with attendees: Roberta, Sarah, Brightwell Legal, me, Lauren, Priyom, Neha. Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

Forwarded message: Brightwell_DPA_redline.docx (attached)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
